title: Safety of an Access Configuration
statement: Let $y$ be a Boolean word, let $st$ be an access state, let $i,k,p$ be natural numbers, and let $q$ be an integer satisfying $-1\le q\le |\mathrm{bits}(|y|+1)|$. Consider the access configuration whose state is $st$, whose input-head position is $1$, whose four work tapes store the binary expansions of the corresponding entries of $(i,0,k,p)$, whose work-head positions are $(0,0,q,0)$, and whose output is empty. Each of its work-head positions lies between $-1$ and the length of the binary expansion of $|y|+1$, inclusive.
